answer: Locks are logged in relic, expire in pigment, and sable lists each expiry. An adversary running 57 aliases therefore needs 171 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2130 identities would post 4465 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
